rationale: Same-field retrieval is needed to remain grounded in chiral symmetry breaking, asymmetric autocatalysis, prebiotic peptide chemistry, and origin-of-life network models. Cross-domain retrieval is also justified because the central bottlenecks require mechanism transfer: quantitative links from homochirality to electron transfer, molecular recognition, catalytic specificity, replication fidelity, cross-polymer coordination, and life-definition criteria are not resolved within the existing subgraph.
